title: Fast VNC
summary: The touchscreen over VNC, about 4x faster than the built-in VNC (Screen Sharing ~2 fps instead of 0.5, TigerVNC ~5), with touch and a pointer. Port 5901 over CoilShift's Tailscale, next to the built-in VNC on 5900. Password "coilshift" unless set. Optional smaller picture.

settings.title: VNC password
settings.summary: Optional. Without one the password is "coilshift". VNC checks only the first 8 characters.

settings.title: Picture size
settings.summary: Full is the touchscreen's own 2560x1600. 1728x1080 fills a 16-inch MacBook in full screen, for viewers that can't scale (TigerVNC). Half is 1280x800, for small screens or slow links.
